protocol.source_validation: two predeclared leave-one-source-domain folds; temporal rolling with 24h embargo
protocol.selection: highest macro heldout-domain AUROC / lowest macro normalized MSE; grid order breaks ties
protocol.diagnostic_curves: every registered grid point, no target-based selection
protocol.replica_unit: 10 independent synthetic draws; real replicates are overlapping source resamples

H1: K16-K4 benefit difference, spurious, N8192, balanced; nine method-task tests
H2: 8:1-minus-balanced benefit difference, spurious, K8,N8192; nine method-task tests

protocol.replay: all methods/configurations of contexts with replica=0, seed=11 on first source fold; max prediction abs diff <=1e-8
protocol.target_policy: new registered targets only; no outcome-dependent changes or retries

statistics.classification_effect: method AUROC minus own config-0 control, macro target-domain then seed means
statistics.regression_effect: (control MSE minus method MSE)/full-source variance, macro target-domain then seed means
statistics.primary_testing: two-sided exact sign test on independent replica contrasts; zeros omitted; Holm across nine tests separately for H1 and H2
statistics.intervals: two-sided Student t 95% intervals over ten independent synthetic data replicas; normality approximation, sign test does not assume normality
statistics.secondary: H3/H4/H5/H6/H7 and real datasets descriptive; no confirmatory claims from unadjusted secondary p-values

source_holdouts.acs: first/last in original selected source-state order: CA and AZ for both K
source_holdouts.synthetic_and_beijing: first and last ordered selected source domains
